decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow is concerned about the loss of open space that the development proposes and would wish to ensure adequate provision to link the riverside walk along the bank of the Thames.
description: Redevelopment and refurbishment of Brunel University site to provide a mixed use scheme comprising 171 new build dwellings incorporating 70 affordable units, 29 private flats, and 73 private houses.  The conversion of Gordon House and stables into 3 residential units and garaging.  The conversion of St Margarets Lodge into 1 residential unit.  The incorporation of The Orangery into residential use.  The use of Clifton Lodge and Violet Needham Chapel for educational and nursery purposes.  The provision of a new healthcare centre.  The use of Gordon House Chapel for office purposes.  The alteration and creation of new vehicular/pedestrian/cycle access and car parking.  (London Borough of Richmond)
